answer: Once per epoch, draw a random lottery of agents who must answer an interactive task in a short window, checked by unrelated peers across the network. A nebula of cloned accounts cannot be everywhere at once, so most of a sybil swarm misses its slot and its weight decays. Like light through a prism, each agent's history splits into a spectrum of distinct attestors, and only identities spanning many independent corners earn full rewards, so a ripple of identical newcomers stands out instantly.
